title: Tensor with the translated unit
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], the recorded derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and canonical two-variable tensor shifts [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. For K in D(O_X), define c_X(K): O_X[1] tensor K -> K[1] as the isomorphism s_(tensorRight K)(1) at the tensor unit followed by the shift of the left unitor O_X tensor K -> K. This is a composite of the recorded isomorphisms, not a choice of an existence witness.
